the litter layers of the boreal conifer forest sites are the most sensitive to changes in soil pH and that the N2O emission potential of these sites is high.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the nitrifier community is sensitive to changes in pH and that the N2O emission from soil is affected by pH.
soil pH and ammonium availability are the main factors controlling N2O production from soils receiving high ammonium input.
soil nitrification potential is not a good indicator of N2O production potential, as the latter is also affected by the availability of oxygen.
